events.subtitle: Blue Note Tokyo debut behind Memory Bomb
events.category: Japan / piano-led modern jazz / jazz-beat crossover
events.factual_description: Blue Note Tokyo presents Kiefer on November 1, 2 and 3, 2026, in his first appearance at the venue. November 1 and 3 have sets at 4:30 PM and 7:30 PM; November 2 has sets at 6:00 PM and 8:30 PM. The venue currently confirms Kiefer on keyboards and piano and marks the remaining personnel TBA. The run follows the September 25 release of Memory Bomb, Kiefer's first leader album for Blue Note Records. Blue Note Records describes the album as produced by Kiefer with Shibo and CARRTOONS and built around collaborations that connect jazz improvisation, beatmaking and hip-hop. Blue Note Tokyo lists a music charge of ¥9,500.

en.why_it_matters: The useful hook is the timing and musical identity: Kiefer reaches Blue Note Tokyo just over a month after his first leader album for Blue Note Records, carrying a piano language that treats jazz improvisation and beatmaking as parts of the same instrument. The live personnel are still unannounced, so the draw is the chance to hear that new Blue Note chapter translated back into a player-centered club setting rather than the label milestone by itself.
en.trip_verdict: If November 1-3 overlaps a Tokyo stay, catch whichever set fits cleanly around stronger anchors. Three nights and six sets make this easy to fold into an Aoyama evening without reorganizing the trip around it.

es.why_it_matters: El gancho está en el momento y en la identidad musical: Kiefer llega a Blue Note Tokyo poco más de un mes después de publicar su primer álbum como líder para Blue Note Records, con un lenguaje de piano donde la improvisación de jazz y el beatmaking funcionan como partes del mismo instrumento. La formación en vivo todavía no está anunciada, así que el interés está en escuchar cómo ese nuevo capítulo se traduce otra vez a un club centrado en tocar, no en el hito discográfico por sí solo.
es.trip_verdict: Si el 1, 2 o 3 de noviembre coincide con una estancia en Tokio, escogería el set que embone mejor alrededor de anclas más fuertes. Tres noches y seis funciones permiten meterlo con facilidad en una noche por Aoyama sin reorganizar el viaje alrededor del concierto.
